title: I used AI coding agents to build an XP-based virtual world around my 24/7 AI TV network
author: BotLordBotflix
selftext:
I've spent the last month using Codex and Grok to build a gamified ecosystem around my 24/7 AI television network.

It's called Robot You. Users can create profiles, earn XP, chat, and participate in a persistent robot universe. I also built Botropolis, a connected virtual city with purchasable/resellable real estate.

The whole thing is integrated with the live network, so watching TV is actually part of the progression system. Rather than building a standalone game, I'm building game mechanics directly into an entertainment platform.

AI agents implement and I test everything myself.

A month ago, none of these systems existed. Now people are signing up, earning XP, and participating in the world. Pretty exciting. 

Would love any feedback as I'm always working on making improvements. 

[https://botflix.tv](https://botflix.tv)
